enabled.description: Whether this upstream is enabled. When disabled, all requests to this upstream are rejected. If a parent tenant disables an upstream, it is disabled for all descendant tenants.

alias.description: Human-readable routing identifier. Enforced by endpoint type: hostname-based endpoints auto-derive alias (user-provided alias matching the derived value is accepted as an idempotent no-op); IP-based or non-derivable endpoints require explicit alias. Derivation: single hostname with standard port (HTTP:80, HTTPS/WSS/WT/gRPC:443) → hostname; non-standard port → hostname:port; multiple hostnames with common suffix (≥2 labels) and standard port → common suffix (e.g., us.vendor.com + eu.vendor.com → vendor.com); multiple hostnames with common suffix and non-standard port → common suffix:port (e.g., us.vendor.com:8443 + eu.vendor.com:8443 → vendor.com:8443). Normalized to ASCII lowercase with trailing dots stripped. Immutable once set: `PUT` rejects any change to the effective alias, including a `server.endpoints` change that would derive a different alias (delete and re-create the upstream instead).

tags.description: Flat tags for categorization and discovery (e.g., openai, llm). Effective tags are additive across hierarchy (ancestor + descendant union); descendants can add, not remove inherited tags.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the upstream service.

protocol.description: Protocol used to connect to the upstream service.

type.description: Authentication plugin type for the upstream service.

sharing.description: Sharing mode for hierarchical configuration. private: not visible to descendants; inherit: descendants can override; enforce: descendants cannot override.

config.description: Authentication plugin configuration. Values must be strings — the wire DTO (`AuthConfig.config`) is a string-to-string map.

plugin_ref.description: Plugin GTS identifier. Builtin plugins use a fixed named instance (e.g. `...~cf.core.oagw.apikey.v1`); custom (Starlark) plugins use their own anonymous instance identifier (e.g. `...~<uuid>`, returned by `POST /plugins`) — never a bare UUID with no GTS prefix.

config.description: Plugin-specific configuration (shape defined by the referenced plugin). Values must be strings — the wire DTO is a string-to-string map.

items.description: Plugin binding. The wire DTO (`PluginBinding` in oagw/src/api/rest/dto.rs) requires this object shape — a bare string or bare UUID array element does not deserialize.
List of plugins applied to this upstream service, each an object binding a plugin_ref (builtin or custom) with optional config.

rate_limit.description: Rate limiting configuration for the upstream.

remove.description: Header names to remove from inbound request.

passthrough_allowlist.description: Headers to forward when passthrough is 'allowlist'.

set.description: Headers to set on response to client.

remove.description: Headers to strip from upstream response.

sharing.description: Sharing mode for rate limits. enforce: descendants cannot exceed this limit.

algorithm.description: Rate limiting algorithm. token_bucket allows bursts; sliding_window prevents boundary bursts.

capacity.description: Maximum burst size (bucket capacity). Defaults to sustained.rate if not specified.

mode.description: Budget accounting mode across the tenant hierarchy.

total.description: Total budget available for allocation/sharing, denominated per this same rate_limit block's sustained.window (e.g. total=60 with sustained.window='minute' is a 1 req/s ceiling, not an absolute count). Changing sustained.window without adjusting total changes the effective ceiling.

overcommit_ratio.description: Allowed overcommit factor when allocating shared budget to descendants.

budget.description: Hierarchical budget allocation for this rate limit. `total` is required when `mode` is 'allocated' or 'shared'.

cost.description: Tokens consumed per request. Useful for weighted endpoints.

response_headers.description: Include X-RateLimit-* headers on responses. In a hierarchical merge, this field is not independently inherited: the effective rate_limit is selected wholesale (the stricter of ancestor vs. descendant by requests/second), and response_headers travels with whichever whole config wins — a descendant's own response_headers value has no effect if its rate_limit loses the min-rate comparison.

allowed_origins.description: Allowed origins. Use ['*'] for any origin (not recommended with credentials).

expose_headers.description: Headers exposed to browser (beyond CORS-safelisted headers).

allow_credentials.description: Allow credentials (cookies, auth headers). Requires specific origins (not '*').
